# Get Into Teaching

> Official DfE resource for aspiring teachers in England covering training routes, career guidance, qualifications, funding, and teacher recruitment.

Get Into Teaching is the Department for Education's primary platform for individuals considering a career in teaching. It provides comprehensive guidance on teacher training pathways (QTS, PGCE, TDA), career progression, subject exploration, and support for career changers, alongside event discovery and school experience opportunities.

## Key Topics

- Qualified Teacher Status (QTS)
- Postgraduate Certificate in Education (PGCE)
- Teacher Degree Apprenticeship (TDA)
- Initial Teacher Training (ITT)
- School Placements
- School Experience
- Career Change to Teaching
- Teaching as a Career
- Pay and Benefits
- SEND (Special Educational Needs and Disabilities)
- Funding and Support
- Teacher Training Routes
- Application Process
- Age Groups and Specialisms

## Getting Started with Teaching

- [Get Into Teaching | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk): Official DfE homepage for teacher training guidance and career pathways
- [How to become a teacher | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/steps-to-become-a-teacher): Step-by-step guide to teacher training, QTS and funding in England
- [Why teach | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/why-teach): Career motivation guide with teacher stories and profession overview
- [Teaching as a career | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/teaching-as-a-career): Career progression and early career teacher support guide

## Teacher Training Routes & Qualifications

- [Train to teach | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher): Main teacher training hub covering QTS routes and PGCE options
- [Train to teach if you have a degree or are studying for one | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/if-you-have-a-degree): Postgraduate teacher training routes for degree holders
- [Qualifications needed to teach | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/qualifications-you-need-to-teach): Reference guide to QTS, PGCE, TDA and entry qualifications
- [What to expect in teacher training | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/initial-teacher-training): Overview of ITT structure, placements and QTS assessment
- [How to choose your teacher training course | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/how-to-choose-your-teacher-training-course): Guide to selecting teacher training providers and course types

## School Experience & Placements

- [Get school experience | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/get-school-experience): Guide to unpaid school experience placements in England
- [Teacher training school placements | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/school-placements): Guide to school placement duration, activities and mentor support
- [Teaching internships | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/teaching-internships): Paid teaching internships in STEM subjects for undergraduates

## Life as a Teacher

- [Pay and benefits | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/pay-and-benefits): Guide to teacher salaries, pensions and career progression benefits
- [Explore subjects you could teach | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/explore-subjects): Subject exploration guide for prospective teachers
- [Age groups and specialisms | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/age-groups-and-specialisms): Guide to primary, secondary, SEND and early years teaching pathways
- [Change careers to teaching | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/life-as-a-teacher/change-careers): Career switcher support and resources for mid-career changers

## Events & Discovery

- [Find an event near you or online | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/events): Event finder for teacher training open days and taster sessions
- [| Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/browse): Browse content hub for teacher training routes and funding options

## Support & Accessibility

- [Adjustments to help you train to teach | Get Into Teaching GOV.UK](https://getintoteaching.education.gov.uk/train-to-be-a-teacher/accessibility-adjustments): Disability support and accessibility adjustments for teacher training
